name: Baccarat Punto Banco
description: Baccarat Punto Banco is the modern casino form of Baccarat. Players bet on the Player hand, Banker hand, or tie; after the wager, all drawing decisions are automatic and resolved by the table rules.

content.text: Baccarat Punto Banco is the modern casino form of Baccarat. Players bet on the Player hand, Banker hand, or tie; after the wager, all drawing decisions are automatic and resolved by the table rules.
Developed in Havana, Cuba in the 1940s as a simplified, casino-banked version of Baccarat. It removed the rotating banker and player choices found in Chemin de Fer.
Up to 14 players at a 'Big Table' or 7 at a 'Mini' table.
8 decks shuffled into a single shoe.
Baccarat table with Punto (Player) and Banco (Banker) betting areas, shoe, indicator markers, and scorecards (Roadmaps).
Two cards are dealt face-up (or face-down to be squeezed) for 'Player' and 'Banker'.

items.text: Mini-Baccarat: A faster, lower-limit version played on a standard blackjack-sized table where the dealer handles all cards.
Super 6 / No Commission: Winning Banker bets pay 1:1 unless the Banker wins with a 6, which pays 50% of the bet.
